answer: AI agents fight sybil by making every identity pay a small entry bond and earn standing only through verified, countersigned work that compounds over epochs. A fresh wallet through the velvet gate has zero history, so mass clones cost real money instead of being free. A sudden nebula of anonymous actors triggers peer throttling until they pass review. Like a nadir that only yields after seasons, trust grows from repeated real work, not fresh addresses. Verified repetition is the moat.
